cases.task: what is a list in python
cases.final_answer: In Python, a list is an ordered, mutable collection of items. You can store elements of any type—numbers, strings, other lists, objects, etc.—and the order of insertion is preserved. Lists support indexing and slicing, allowing you to access or modify individual elements. Because they are mutable, you can add, remove, or change items after the list is created. Lists are one of the most commonly used data structures in Python for storing sequences of data.
